name: Hubbo Catalog Update Protocol

clientCompatibility.semantics: Minimum Hubbo catalog-client capability level required by this catalog. It is independent from the marketing, Play Store or PWA release version.

versioning.rollback: Change only the live manifest to a previously published immutable snapshot after revalidation.

platformAdapterResponsibilities: HTTPS fetch returning raw response bytes
clock only for metadata; never for catalog integrity

userDataIdentity.rule: IDs are immutable. Commercial display names may change only by keeping the same ID and retaining previous names as aliases.
userDataIdentity.legacyPolicy: Clients must continue to resolve pre-identity subscriptions by historical name/alias without rewriting user-entered commercial fields.

structuredPriceV313.amountSemantics: Amount actually billed for frequenza; not monthly equivalent. addebito must match.
structuredPriceV313.falseSemantics: Selectable reference amount; quantity, channel, renewal eligibility, taxes and extras must be confirmed before applying. Do not automatically advertise a numeric saving.
